modern: Connection and value meet disruption and freedom. Attraction runs electric, sudden, and unattached to convention. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Erratic affections, sudden attractions and ruptures, and a refusal to be tied down. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: One side wants to preserve the agreement while the other insists that staying requires a completely different arrangement. The familiar price, role, invitation, or commitment is defended as fair; the person seeking change points to restrictions and needs the original deal no longer recognizes. Venus holds the value of continuity and mutual consideration, while Uranus gives the demand for independence equal force. The opposition places belonging and freedom across from each other without allowing either to be reduced to selfishness. A revised agreement may emerge, but the relationship cannot return to the version that depended on one person staying quiet.
